parameter.name: basetopic
parameter.label: Base Topic
parameter.description: MQTT prefix of the clock, as shown in its MQTT settings. By default this is the 12 character MAC address of the clock.

parameter.name: appLockTimeout
parameter.label: App Selection Timeout
parameter.description: Timeout until a selected app returns control and the app rotation continues.

parameter.name: discoverDefaultApps
parameter.label: Discover Built-in Apps
parameter.description: Also discover the built-in apps of the clock (Time, Date, ...).

parameter.name: lowBatteryThreshold
parameter.label: Low Battery Threshold
parameter.description: Battery level below which the low battery channel is set, if the clock does not report it itself.
